subject: Post-demo: deployment decision checklist & migration inputs
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Carter <sara.carter@brightpay.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightpay.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: deployment decision checklist & migration inputs

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great questions from the BrightPay team. Quick recap and a simple checklist so we can line up the next steps for a decision between Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private (VPC/on-prem):

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Primary goal: replace legacy GPU cluster for inference serving for payroll NLP features (high-throughput batch scoring + some low-latency interactive requests).
- Compliance: US-only payroll data, need audit logs and SOC2 artifacts; potential future EU expansion.
- Procurement timeline: procurement team expects vendor shortlist in ~3 weeks; pilot target in ~6–8 weeks.
- Cost sensitivity: focused on predictable monthly run-rate; willing to consider reserved capacity if ROI clear.

Checklist / qualification items we need to finalize mode recommendation:
1) Throughput profile (tokens/sec or requests/min for peak batch windows) — helps decide Dedicated vs Hosted.
2) Percent of latency-sensitive requests (p95 latency SLO target).
3) Data residency & egress constraints (can data be processed in a US cloud region or must be on-prem?).
4) Integration constraints (can BrightPay accept a private VPC peering, or prefer a managed API?).
5) Procurement constraints (vendor security questionnaire items, required SLAs/terms).

I attached a short migration workbook (BrightPay_Redwood_Migration_Workbook.xlsx) — fill the highlighted rows for point #1 and #2 and upload to the shared Drive link. Based on what you fill, we can map expected qps to one of: Hosted (fastest onboarding), Dedicated (predictable capacity, reserved GPU pools), Private VPC/on-prem (for strict network controls).

Proposed next steps:
- Sara / Tom: complete workbook for throughput & latency windows by Tue 16 Jun.
- Aditya: prepare a MID-LEVEL cost estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated and an outline of Private deployment prerequisites.
- Aisha: prepare SOC2 artifact checklist and procurement pack for BrightPay.
- Schedule a 30-min decision workshop the week of Jun 22 to review outputs.

Attachment: BrightPay_Redwood_Migration_Workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, please fill and re-upload)

Regards,
Aditya Rao

Thanks — the recap is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side before we dig into the workbook: 

1) For Dedicated, what is the minimum reservation period and the typical commit sizes? We need numbers to show finance.
2) For Private VPC, can you summarize required networking (peer vs VPN) and whether an air-gapped on-prem install is supported?
3) About migration: our legacy cluster uses mixed GPU types (A100 + older gen). Will Redwood handle model conversion/quantization, or do we need to re-export models?

Attached our RFP doc with a few security questions filled (BrightPay_RFP_Q2-2026.pdf). We'll aim to complete the workbook by Mon morning but want answers to 1–3 to inform the capacity estimates.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment decision checklist & migration inputs

Hi Sara — great questions, answers below and a few concrete asks so we can size everything cleanly: 

Q1) Dedicated reservations: typical reserved terms are 3 / 6 / 12 months. Minimum commit varies by region but finance-friendly examples: 6-week onboarding credit + 3-mo reservation example for POC to production. I'll attach a short one-pager with sample pricing bands (Redwood_Deployment_Options_OnePager.pdf).

Q2) Private VPC: we support VPC peering for cloud-hosted private control plane (recommended). VPN is supported for customer-managed networking. On-prem (air-gapped) is possible via our private package but requires slightly longer lead time for packaging, KMS integration, and acceptance testing (4–8 weeks). We'll list the exact network ports and certificate requirements in the procurement pack Aisha will share.

Q3) Migration support: Redwood will assist with model conversion and recommended quantization profiles for throughput/cost tradeoffs. For very old custom runtimes we may need model exports in standard formats (PyTorch/ONNX); our Applied ML team (cc Marissa) will run a conversion/benchmark pass as part of pilot. 

Please fill these specific rows in the workbook before our workshop:
- Peak batch qps (requests/min) and average request size (tokens) for payroll batch windows.
- Percent of requests that require <200ms p95 latency.
- Any data segments that must remain on-prem or cannot leave your VPC.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Sara / Tom: workbook inputs (Mon 2026-06-15 EOD).
- Aditya: pricing bands + sample SOW and one-pager (Tue 2026-06-16).
- Aisha: SOC2 artifacts + procurement checklist (Tue 2026-06-16).
- Marissa: set up AMI/workbench bench test for model conversion during pilot.

Attachment: Redwood_Deployment_Options_OnePager.pdf; BrightPay_Redwood_Migration_Workbook.xlsx (blank rows noted)

Thanks — we'll use the Monday inputs to finalize a clear recommendation (likely Dedicated if you need predictable monthly run-rate + some caching to cut cost; Hosted if you prioritize fastest pilot). Private VPC makes sense if procurement and network controls require it.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
From: Sara Carter <sara.carter@brightpay.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment decision checklist & migration inputs

Thanks — we've filled the workbook and uploaded it to the Drive folder you shared. Highlights: 
- Peak batch windows: 10 batch jobs / day, peak batch qps ~ 1,200 requests/min, avg request ~ 650 tokens.
- ~30% of requests are interactive and need <200ms p95.
- Data residency: payroll PII must remain in US cloud region; no on-prem requirement for initial pilot.
- Procurement: we'll share a short vendor shortlist timeline; finance prefers 3- or 6-month proof-of-value before longer-term commit.

Next steps: please send the sample price bands and sample SOW (Aditya), and Marissa please propose pilot sizing/bench timeline. We'll schedule the decision workshop for Jun 23, 30-min.

Best,
Sara
Senior Product Manager | BrightPay
